write_up: Your resume points to Staff Accountant and Accounts Payable Specialist roles. It tells a useful story: senior accounting work in Vietnam followed by bookkeeping and accounts payable work in Houston. A recruiter can see both your accounting background and the volume you handle now.

The strongest line is the reduction in month-end closing from 12 days to 7 days. It names the change and the checklist and template you made to achieve it. Your current invoice line is also useful: it names the monthly volume and QuickBooks.

A recruiter could move this forward with a couple of questions. Let's start with what you do for the controller at month-end, then add what your junior accountants worked on. A final proofreading pass would also help the accounting work come through cleanly.
